hypothesis: During repeated nonpositive progress, retaining a bypass side while continuing GRU value ranking can reduce failed reversals without forcing unsafe forward progress, beyond fixed8 progress intervention.
scope: Existing-method adaptation, NOT an official TEB reproduction, new learned recovery algorithm, or established novelty. No training.

upstream.reused: One-sided squared direction penalty and retained direction state from oscillation recovery.
upstream.not_reused: ROS, g2o optimizer, nonholonomic yaw dynamics, homotopy search, TEB collision constraints. Full TEB would change the action/planning contract.

controller.trigger: Exactly the existing commit8 trigger:8 consecutive nominal nonpositive-progress decisions and no goal-distance reduction over last8 executed steps.
controller.axis: Unit direction from robot to goal at activation; retained for8 steps.
controller.side: Sign of current actual velocity cross activation goal axis; if lateral speed<=1e-6, use the highest-scoring safe candidate with nonzero lateral velocity; if none, no side penalty.
controller.bearing: asin(clip(cross(axis,executed_candidate_velocity)/max(speed,1e-12),-1,1)); treats forward/backward motion on the same lateral side equally. This replaces TEB yaw increment for a holonomic robot.
controller.penalty: std(original finite safe scores) * max(0,-side*bearing)^2; subtract from original scores; select only original safe candidates. No progress bonus. No extra actions. No future human state.
controller.empty_safe_set: Cancel active interval and execute unchanged nominal fallback; do not replace it with an unvalidated safety fallback.
controller.limits: Not a long-term safety certificate. Trigger and duration inherited without tuning; scale deterministic from within-step safe scores, not navigation outcomes.

side_reset: Same trigger,8-step interval and penalty, but recompute axis and preferred side each active step. Isolates retained-side state from mere directional penalty.

development.reuse: Existing nominal and commit8 complete outcomes and logs; only the2 side arms are new. These cases are already development, not fresh confirmation.

controls.determinism: Repeat side-latched smoke, exactly matching executed actions, physical traces, candidate values and outcomes; timings excluded.
controls.activation_unit_tests: Synthetic triggers, fixed direction retention, empty-mask fallback, finite score scaling without masked -1e9, translation/rotation equivariance, safe selection and explicit direction perturbation sensitivity.

development_go: At least2 additional successes versus commit8 AND more successes than nominal; no increase in collision/contact versus either; mechanism changes executed choices; paired both-success duration increase<=10%. Otherwise KILL this adaptation without repair/sweep.

confirmation.rule: No tuning. Candidate must improve paired SR over commit8 with cluster bootstrap lower bound>0, no collision/contact regression, and not be fully absorbed by side-reset; otherwise no method entry.

statistics: Resample numerical case jointly across6 scenes,4000 paired bootstrap draws. Report20 case clusters per120-episode cohort; one nominal training seed, not population policy generalization.
engineering_stop: Any traceback/nonzero exit/nonfinite score/action contract, weight hash, import path or exact tape/parity failure stops outcome evaluation until the specific engineering failure is recorded and corrected. No scientific rescue.
resources: Local3060 inference only, no4090, no training, no original project source edits.
